summary: DirectX texture surface blit with color-space conversion. Lazily allocates an intermediate conversion buffer (width*256 bytes, row-count width*16) on first call, updates cached source width/height when the incoming offsets change, blits scanlines through an indirect row-blit callback, copies 16-byte pixels from the conversion buffer to the output surface pointer at this+0x10, and optionally runs a channel-decode pass (scale factors 31.0/63.0/31.0 and 1/31, 1/63) that zeros pixels whose decoded RGBA equals a reference color. Returns a DWORD read from dword_8B009C on the decode path.
